key: Oh, I'm free!
en: Oh, I'm free!
ja: ああ、自由だ!

key: I was careless enough to fall into a pit trap, and was sure I'd be forgotten down here forever.
en: I was careless enough to fall into a pit trap, and was sure I'd be forgotten down here forever.
ja: うかつにも落とし穴にはまってしまって、もうここで一生忘れられるものだと思っていたよ。

key: Thanks so much! I'll get back to the station right away!
en: Thanks so much! I'll get back to the station right away!
ja: 本当にありがとう! すぐに署に戻るよ!

key: Something unseeable is in the way.
en: Something unseeable is in the way.
ja: 目に見えない何かが立ちふさがっている。

key: \PN used the Silvon Scope.
en: \PN used the Silvon Scope.
ja: \PNはシルボンスコープを使った。

key: The startled Pokémon attacked!
en: The startled Pokémon attacked!
ja: 驚いたポケモンが攻撃してきた!

key: Kekk...
en: Kekk...
ja: ケーック……

key: ...Leeeon!!!
en: ...Leeeon!!!
ja: ……レーーオン!!!

key: PURPLE KECLEON: ...kek.
en: PURPLE KECLEON: ...kek.
ja: むらさきのカクレオン: ……けく。

key: The bully Pokémon attacked!
en: The bully Pokémon attacked!
ja: いじわるなポケモンが攻撃してきた!

key: Keckk--!
en: Keckk--!
ja: ケック――!

key: PURPLE KECLEON: ...
en: PURPLE KECLEON: ...
ja: むらさきのカクレオン: ……

key: ...ckleon...
en: ...ckleon...
ja: ……クレオン……

key: TREECKO: Tree--!
en: TREECKO: Tree--!
ja: キモリ: キモ――!

key: Treecko seems bewildered.
en: Treecko seems bewildered.
ja: キモリはとまどっているようだ。

key: Would you like to take Treecko with you?
en: Would you like to take Treecko with you?
ja: キモリを連れていきますか?

key: NUZLEAF: Nuzz! Za, za!
en: NUZLEAF: Nuzz! Za, za!
ja: コノハナ: コノ! ハナ、ハナ!

key: NUZLEAF: La-za!
en: NUZLEAF: La-za!
ja: コノハナ: ラ・ハナ!

key: The Key reacted to the Crystal!
en: The Key reacted to the Crystal!
ja: カギがクリスタルに反応した!

key: Take it?
en: Take it?
ja: 取りますか?

key: It seems the Egg wasn't abandoned after all.
en: It seems the Egg wasn't abandoned after all.
ja: タマゴは、結局置き去りにされていたわけではないようだ。

key: GROAAAWWWARRR!!
en: GROAAAWWWARRR!!
ja: ゴアアアアアウワアアア!!

key: An Egg seems to have been abandoned here.
en: An Egg seems to have been abandoned here.
ja: タマゴが置き去りにされているようだ。

key: Take the Egg?
en: Take the Egg?
ja: タマゴを持っていきますか?

key: \PN got the Egg!
en: \PN got the Egg!
ja: \PNはタマゴを手に入れた!

key: Skrelp is vacantly staring across the water.
en: Skrelp is vacantly staring across the water.
ja: クズモーがぼんやりと水の向こうを見つめている。

key: It seems familiar.
en: It seems familiar.
ja: 何か見覚えがあるようだ。

key: Skrelp noticed the Silver Ring!
en: Skrelp noticed the Silver Ring!
ja: クズモーがぎんのゆびわに気づいた!

key: Skrelp seems obedient. Do you want to take it with you?
en: Skrelp seems obedient. Do you want to take it with you?
ja: クズモーはおとなしくなっているようだ。連れていきますか?

key: It doesn't seem to respond to anything you do.
en: It doesn't seem to respond to anything you do.
ja: 何をしても、反応がないようだ。

key: Seviper is lapping up water from the pool.
en: Seviper is lapping up water from the pool.
ja: ハブネークが水たまりの水をなめている。

key: Seviper noticed \PN's Pokésnax!
en: Seviper noticed \PN's Pokésnax!
ja: ハブネークが\PNのポケスナックに気づいた!

key: SEVIPER: Sssse-?
en: SEVIPER: Sssse-?
ja: ハブネーク: シュー?

key: Seviper lunged for the Pokésnax!
en: Seviper lunged for the Pokésnax!
ja: ハブネークがポケスナックに飛びついた!

key: It refuses to acknowledge anything else.
en: It refuses to acknowledge anything else.
ja: それ以外のことには、まるで反応しない。

key: SHELLY: I don't-- I don't understand?
en: SHELLY: I don't-- I don't understand?
ja: シェリー: わ、わからない……?

key: I saw some Pokémon running away from here and traced them back to this point...
en: I saw some Pokémon running away from here and traced them back to this point...
ja: ここから逃げていくポケモンを見かけて、たどってきたら、ここに行き着いたの……

key: And then it's as you see here--
en: And then it's as you see here--
ja: それで、見ての通りなんだけど――

key: There's all these weird cells around the roots, but I don't understand why?
en: There's all these weird cells around the roots, but I don't understand why?
ja: 根っこの周りに変なセルがたくさんあるんだけど、どうしてか全然わからなくて。

key: Why are they here?
en: Why are they here?
ja: どうして、ここにあるの?

key: What does it even mean?
en: What does it even mean?
ja: 一体、どういうことなの?

key: SHELLY: \PN, perfect timing!
en: SHELLY: \PN, perfect timing!
ja: シェリー: \PN、ちょうどよかった!

key: Did you end up getting the 100% Zygarde!?
en: Did you end up getting the 100% Zygarde!?
ja: 100%フォルムのジガルデ、手に入れられた?!

key: SHELLY: You really got it!
en: SHELLY: You really got it!
ja: シェリー: 本当に手に入れたんだね!

key: Okay, so hear me out.
en: Okay, so hear me out.
ja: よし、それじゃ聞いて。

key: SHELLY: At first I was confused why a bunch of Z- Cells appeared down here...
en: SHELLY: At first I was confused why a bunch of Z- Cells appeared down here...
ja: シェリー: 最初は、どうしてここにZセルがたくさん現れたのか、よくわからなくて……

key: They have the same shape as the barriers in the tree itself, which maybe makes sense if they traveled through the root system.
en: They have the same shape as the barriers in the tree itself, which maybe makes sense if they traveled through the root system.
ja: あれ、木のバリアと同じ形をしてるの。根っこを伝って移動してきたって考えれば、筋が通るかもしれない。

key: Then I was thinking, there's supposed to be an Yveltal up there, right?
en: Then I was thinking, there's supposed to be an Yveltal up there, right?
ja: それで思ったんだけど、上にはイベルタルがいるはずでしょ?

key: There's an obvious connection with linked Legendaries spawning in the same spaces--
en: There's an obvious connection with linked Legendaries spawning in the same spaces--
ja: 同じ場所につながりのある伝説のポケモンが現れるのって、絶対関係があるはずで――

key: Perhaps the barriers are simply parts of a Zygarde that didn't form properly?
en: Perhaps the barriers are simply parts of a Zygarde that didn't form properly?
ja: もしかして、あのバリアは、うまく形にならなかったジガルデの一部なんじゃないかな?

key: And since the parts of that Zygarde are appearing down here by the roots, just like in the legend...
en: And since the parts of that Zygarde are appearing down here by the roots, just like in the legend...
ja: それで、そのジガルデの一部が、伝説の通りにここの根元に現れてるなら……

key: You get it, right?
en: You get it, right?
ja: わかるでしょ?

key: Right here-- we can use the roots to channel an attack throughout the entire tree system and clear out all the barriers at once!
en: Right here-- we can use the roots to channel an attack throughout the entire tree system and clear out all the barriers at once!
ja: ここなら――根っこを使って、木全体に攻撃を伝えて、バリアを一気に消し去れるはずよ!

key: Send out your Zygarde here, and let's try it!
en: Send out your Zygarde here, and let's try it!
ja: ここでジガルデを出して、試してみましょう!

key: SHELLY: Okay, Zygarde-- focus your power through the roots!
en: SHELLY: Okay, Zygarde-- focus your power through the roots!
ja: シェリー: よし、ジガルデ――根っこを通して、力を集中させて!

key: Full power, let's go!
en: Full power, let's go!
ja: 全力で、いくよ!

key: SHELLY: Okay, I think Zygarde absorbed the erratic energy from the tree, so it should be all good now!
en: SHELLY: Okay, I think Zygarde absorbed the erratic energy from the tree, so it should be all good now!
ja: シェリー: よし、ジガルデが木の不安定なエネルギーを吸収してくれたと思う、これでもう大丈夫なはず!

key: SHELLY: W-what?
en: SHELLY: W-what?
ja: シェリー: な、なに?

key: Where'd this Ditto come from?
en: Where'd this Ditto come from?
ja: このメタモン、どこから出てきたの?

key: Well, I don't know what the deal with this is, but it came out of your Pokémon, so you should probably take it...
en: Well, I don't know what the deal with this is, but it came out of your Pokémon, so you should probably take it...
ja: ええと、何がどうなってるのかわからないけど、あなたのポケモンから出てきたから、多分あなたが引き取った方がいいと思う……

key: SHELLY: Anyway, I think Zygarde absorbed the erratic energy from the tree, so it should be all good now!
en: SHELLY: Anyway, I think Zygarde absorbed the erratic energy from the tree, so it should be all good now!
ja: シェリー: とにかく、ジガルデが木の不安定なエネルギーを吸収してくれたと思うから、これでもう大丈夫なはず!

key: SHELLY: I'm going to check one or two more things down here, but then I'll be all on for support!
en: SHELLY: I'm going to check one or two more things down here, but then I'll be all on for support!
ja: シェリー: もう一つ二つ、ここで確認したいことがあるけど、それが終わったらしっかりサポートするから!

key: Let's save Noel once and for all!
en: Let's save Noel once and for all!
ja: もう決着をつけて、ノエルを助けよう!

key: SHELLY: Only a 100% Zygarde has enough power to break through!
en: SHELLY: Only a 100% Zygarde has enough power to break through!
ja: シェリー: 突破できるだけの力があるのは、100%フォルムのジガルデだけ!

key: At least, I'm-- I'm pretty sure...
en: At least, I'm-- I'm pretty sure...
ja: 少なくとも……多分そのはず……

key: But you should be able to get one by now.
en: But you should be able to get one by now.
ja: でも、もう手に入れられるはずだよ。

key: You can do it, \PN!
en: You can do it, \PN!
ja: できるよ、\PN!

key: You've come this far; far enough that something like this can't stop you!
en: You've come this far; far enough that something like this can't stop you!
ja: ここまで来たんだもの、こんなことで止まったりしないはずよ!

key: I just wanna double check and make sure that blasting an attack like that through the tree won't have damaged it...
en: I just wanna double check and make sure that blasting an attack like that through the tree won't have damaged it...
ja: あんな攻撃を木全体に通しちゃって、木が傷ついてないか、念のため確認しておきたいの……

key: This rock is glowing with energy inside...
en: This rock is glowing with energy inside...
ja: この　いわの　なかで　エネルギーが　かがやいている……

key: Do you want to mine the rock?
en: Do you want to mine the rock?
ja: いわを　さいくつしますか？

key: It seems too sturdy to break or move...
en: It seems too sturdy to break or move...
ja: 頑丈すぎて、壊したり動かしたりできそうにない……

key: The rock base may hold more valuables.
en: The rock base may hold more valuables.
ja: この岩の土台には、まだ何か貴重なものが眠っているかもしれない。

key: Do you want to open it with Blast Powder?
en: Do you want to open it with Blast Powder?
ja: ばくはつのこなで開けますか?

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
